violation_type.title: Machine Wash Cloth Toys (26 TAC §746.3407(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained, the infant cloth toys are sprayed with sanitizer and not washed weekly.

finding_variants.text: Based on the evidence obtained, the infant cloth toys are sprayed with sanitizer and not washed weekly.
Cloth toys in young toddler room were soiled. Pillows in the older toddler room were dirty. This was corrected at inspection when the items were removed from the classrooms.
As per caregivers, cloth toys in the infant classroom are being machine washed every two or three weeks. Two of the cloth toys were observed to be in use during inspection.
A  bouncer play equipment needed to be sanitized and washed.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when the bouncer play equipment was removed from the classroom to be sanitized.
